issue_context.title: Feature Request: Implement Nodeinfo endpoints for federation discovery
issue_context.body:
Nodeinfo is a way to expose certain metadata about a server for use of discovery regarding functionality of its federation capabilities.

Two endpoints are required:
1. `/.well-known/nodeinfo` which informs client where it can find the location of the location of its metadata (including which version of the schema is used)
2. the endpoint which exposes the metadata in json format according to schema.

Notes:
* `openRegistrations` is a required field, but I propose to set to false as default in case someone writes a crawler to discover "open" gitea instances
* to limit data leakage I also propose to not include the `usage` field (note it is required so it should be included, but left as empty).

More info:
https://github.com/jhass/nodeinfo
https://github.com/jhass/nodeinfo/tree/main/schemas/2.1
http://nodeinfo.diaspora.software/protocol.html

cc: @pilou-

review_comments: But we don't currently support activitypub do we?

per the schema, this requires a minimum length of 1 (https://github.com/jhass/nodeinfo/blob/main/schemas/2.1/schema.json#L54), and I figured this PR is the start of activitypub so it's ok to include it.
`git` until we have the first federation api?
`git` is not a supported value in this field (check the link I provided for possible values)
That will be outdated as soon as `Gitea` will be migrated to `gitea.com`
I think we can change it after migration, now I think it's okay.

Is the name intended to be the general-purpose name (`gitea`),
the hostname (i.e. `try.gitea.io`), or the instance-specific name (i.e. `General Purpose Gitea`)?
If it is the first one, which I assume, will the instance-specific name and hostname be sent somewhere else as well, or will it simply be omitted?

See https://github.com/jhass/nodeinfo/blob/main/schemas/2.1/schema.json

It's "The canonical name of this server software."
